discription: A simple plucked string sound using filtered white noise for excitation and a resonant lowpass filter with a quick decay envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, decayTime=0.3, rq=0.01; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.perc(0.01, decayTime), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = WhiteNoise.ar(0.5) * env; sig = RLPF.ar(sig, freq, rq); sig = sig * amp; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
